features.title: Command-line agents become a loop
features.what: It turns an agent session into work that continues on its own.
features.evidence_quote: Agent Autoloop turns your command-line agents into a background loop.

features.title: One machine, one install
features.what: It runs locally on the three desktop systems, with no cloud server.
features.evidence_quote: One machine, one install command. Runs on Windows, macOS, or Linux. No cloud server or inbound ports required.

features.title: Events and rules
features.what: A schedule, an issue or an alert becomes an event that your rules route.
features.evidence_quote: A 9:00 AM schedule, a new GitHub issue, or a production alert becomes a standard event sent to the kernel.

features.title: One round, then exit
features.what: The agent finishes a round, reports in its final message and the process ends.
features.evidence_quote: The agent puts its result in its final message, and the process exits.

features.title: Cards where you already are
features.what: Decisions arrive as chat cards or desktop notifications.
features.evidence_quote: Cards reach you on Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack, Discord, or desktop notifications when you are needed.

features.title: Command-line output is still Chinese
features.what: The terminal output and default notifications have not been translated yet.
features.evidence_quote: CLI output and default notification strings are still Chinese until they are translated.

risks.text: CLI output and default notification text are Chinese until translated.
It needs a recent Node, Git and an agent that is already signed in.
